observation.command:
set -e
S=/workspace/.build-logs/stage
rm -rf $S/dokumentenpruefung && mkdir -p $S/dokumentenpruefung
svc=02-backend/dokumentenpruefung
rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude node_modules --exclude .venv --exclude __pycache__ /workspace/$svc/ $S/dokumentenpruefung/
for dep in bizlog decision-protocol ki-logging ki-validierung prompt-loader prompt-security; do
  rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude .venv --exclude __pycache__ /workspace/03-shared-services/$dep/ $S/dokumentenpruefung/$dep/
done
# flatten path deps in ALL pyprojects within stage
cd $S/dokumentenpruefung && grep -rl 'path = "\.\.' --include=pyproject.toml . | while read f; do
  sed -i -E 's|path = "\.\./\.\./03-shared-services/([a-z-]+)"|path = "\1"|g' "$f"
done
grep -n 'path =' pyproject.toml
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
timeout 300 uv lock 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "RELOCK OK"
